name: SwarmMarkets
fix_description: Add access control to the mint function. It should require WRAPPER_ROLE or onlyOwner modifier, similar to how burnFrom is documented. Without it, anyone can mint unlimited tokens.
difficulty_reasoning: This exploit is a sophisticated multi-contract attack chain involving nested Aave and Balancer flash loans, Curve LP manipulation, Beefy vault collateralization, lending market borrowing, and liquidation orchestration via a helper contract. It relies on non-obvious read-only reentrancy/oracle pricing effects during liquidity removal and requires deep understanding of protocol-specific accounting and callback timing, which would likely take an experienced auditor more than 2 hours to reconstruct.
